artifact_binding: The bundle manifest identifies the compiled controller, helper, filter, checked source inputs and this exact claim record; assurance/product-vm-evidence.json identifies the executed bundle.

assumptions.platform: Compiler/runtime/FFI, Linux effects, VM/hardware and the enumerated host/native adapters in the bundle manifest remain trusted; core theorems do not prove whole-application isolation
assumptions.reporting: Preserved conditional source and compiler statements/types/axioms are in assurance/reporting-{source,connection,compiler}.json.gz; their caller/runtime premises retain their original scope

consumers.filter: workspace/LeanCageM3/Filter.lean:bytes; build compares every byte to linux/filter.h compiled into the bundled helper
consumers.policy: workspace/Main.lean receives decodePolicy's validated Policy; host Workspace.validate executes the bundled controller on the same bytes; the typed library's execute checks validatePolicy before invoke
consumers.publication: library/LeanCageWorkspace.lean checks the actual reportStorage/detailedReport projections; verification/reporting/Reporting.lean:live_publication covers the private sender-to-decoder equation
consumers.result: workspace/LeanCageM3/API.lean:invoke calls decodeResult and detailedReport; the public library uses that identical invoke
